name: Falling Into Your Smile
description: After joining an all-male e-sports team, an amateur gamer tests her skills and leads her team to the world championships.

videos.title: Invitation
videos.overview: Tong Yao is asked to join a professional gaming team after passing a secret test but since there are no female gamers in the whole league she is unsure whether to join.

videos.title: Official Signing
videos.overview: Tong Yao goes to the ZGDX headquarters to start training with the other members of the team. Her arrival gets off to a rocky start with two of the team members as well as her mother who does not approve of her career choice.

videos.title: Seeking Reconciliation
videos.overview: Jianyang, Lu Sicheng, and Tong Yao play a game online and start love triangle rumors when the conversations are leaked and labeled as flirty. Tong Yao's parents see these rumors and start to worry about her situation.

videos.title: First Victory
videos.overview: After winning a training match the team goes out to celebrate but when they come back to their training headquarters they find two unexpected guests waiting for them.

videos.title: Mental Breakdown
videos.overview: After the guests leave ZGDX headquarters the team is challenged to a training competition by TAT but Lu Sicheng turns it down knowing they just want to target Tong Yao and demoralize her. Tong Yao finally does her first game on webcam.

videos.title: Hateful Comments
videos.overview: Tong Yao and Jinyang go out to take their mind off their troubles. Tong Yao gets drunk and is escorted back to headquarters by Lu Sicheng when she meets Lu Yue an earlier ZGDX midlaner who just came off a suspension.

videos.title: The Past
videos.overview: Tong Yao remembers the previous night and decides she can only face her team members by wearing a mask. Tong Yao sees that there is friction between the team and Lu Yue over a prior incident that involves God Ming.

videos.title: Setting the Record Straight
videos.overview: Ai Jai gets on a Livestream and explains Brother A's intention and why Lu Yue fought him. Xiao Pang, Old K realize their mistake and make amends with Lu Yue meanwhile Lu Yue and Tang Yao continue to compete for starting position.

videos.title: Official Team Photos
videos.overview: ZGDX arrives for their photoshoot but Lu Sicheng and Tong Yao encounter an awkward moment right before she takes her pictures. ZGDX plays YQCB and Lu Sicheng realizes that a friend from his past has come back.

videos.title: Powering Through
videos.overview: With the first game of the National League approaching the teams to choose their opponents and groups for the competition. With this in mind ZGDX also chooses their starting midlaner.

videos.title: Falling Sick
videos.overview: ZGDX defeats RK and a bitter Jianyang. Sicheng and Tong Yao end up taking care of each other.

videos.title: Jealousy
videos.overview: News of Tong Yao and Sicheng's sleepover is revealed during a livestream. Jianyang makes another attempt to win Tong Yao back.

videos.title: Commanding Respect
videos.overview: ZGDX destroys their match with KING. Tong Yao steps in to comfort an opponent and tells Sicheng she wants to play TAT again.

videos.title: Blind Date
videos.overview: With her teammates' help, Tong Yao defeats A Tai from TAT. Meanwhile, Sicheng's mom sets him up on a blind date.

videos.title: Marking Territory
videos.overview: At the next match, Tong Yao comes under attack from FNC's Kun. Sicheng leads ZGDX to victory, but finds another competitor for Tong Yao.

videos.title: A Touch of Intimacy
videos.overview: Su Luo buys flowers for Sicheng, who takes everyone shoe shopping. Tong Yao defeats Sicheng in a live solo match.

videos.title: The Smear Campaign
videos.overview: Sicheng turns down Su Luo. At an anime convention, Tong Yao gets into a fight and is suspended for one game.

videos.title: Secret Support
videos.overview: Sicheng refuses to talk to Tong Yao, but still brigs her food, prompting her to apologize. Lu Yue fills in for Tong Yao for the first time.

videos.title: In the Crosshairs
videos.overview: After Tong Yao's cat eats one of Sicheng's goldfishes, she takes him to buy another one. Tong Yao is reinstated to pay.

videos.title: Love Confession
videos.overview: Although ZGDX wins their next match, Tong Yao is disappointed by the industry as she is targeted by the opposing players for her gender.

videos.title: Dating
videos.overview: Sicheng confesses his feelings to Tong Yao and gives her until 9 p.m. to respond.

videos.title: Making a Comeback
videos.overview: Chen Jinyang and Ai Jia face difficulties in their relationship after she's criticized for not showing interest in his matches.

videos.title: Love Goes Public
videos.overview: Tong Yao and Sicheng are photographed holding hands. ZGDX attends an event in Xiamen.

videos.title: Buying the Team
videos.overview: Jinyang persuades her father to buy YQCB and hosts an esports tournament. Tong Yao and Sicheng go public with their relationship.

videos.title: Conflict
videos.overview: News of Tong Yao and Sicheng's relationship causes a stir. ZGDX loses a match due to Lao K and Lao Mao, but fans blame Tong Yao instead.

videos.title: A Parcel of Terror
videos.overview: Tong Yao finally becomes the MVP, but is hurt by a mysterious package. She's forced to sit out of the next game, making Sicheng furious.

videos.title: Defeated
videos.overview: The fan who sent the package releases a video, changing the public opinion on Tong Yao. Sicheng takes it upon himself to set things right.

videos.title: Hand Injury Relapse
videos.overview: The team hits a low point after losing a key match. Sicheng reveals what he's been up to.

videos.title: Advancing to the Top Four
videos.overview: Sicheng accompanies Tong Yao to meet her parents. ZGDX participates in a new tournament, where they must face off against CK again.

videos.title: Birthday Celebration
videos.overview: ZGDX surprises Tong Yao on her birthday and prepares to play in the nationals against YQCB.

videos.title: Claiming the Crown
videos.overview: ZGDX puts everything on the line as they compete against YQCB to take home the title of national champions.
